concept_uz: Aeroportda qiz doʻstiga yozgan xabarini bitta raqam xato bilan notanish odamga yuborib qoʻyadi. Ism ham, rasm ham yoʻq — oylab yozishishadi. Uchrashuv kuni maʼlum boʻladi: u bir yildan beri har ertalab xuddi shu kafeda, uch stol narida oʻtirgan ekan.

facts.claim: Xabar eski doʻstga moʻljallangan edi; bitta raqam xato terilgan
Hikoyachi aeroport polida, reys kechikkan, quvvatlagich ishlamaydi
Notanish bir necha daqiqada javob berdi: «ogʻir kecha», «yaxshi boʻlib ketar» va aeroport qahvasi haqida hazil
Rasm almashishmadi, haqiqiy ism aytishmadi; oylar davomida ogʻir kunlar va kichik gʻalabalar haqida yozishdi
Uchrashuvni notanish taklif qildi — hikoyachining uyi yonidagi kafeda
Barista kulib, uch stol naridagi yigitni koʻrsatdi: u bir yildan beri har ertalab xuddi shu vaqtda kelardi; ikkalasi telefonga band boʻlib bir-birini payqamagan
Hikoyachining jinsi va qahramonlar qiyofasi matnda yoʻq — videoda tanlangan; aeroport qahvasi haqidagi soʻnggi hazil manba hazilining davomi sifatida qoʻshilgan

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, soft intimate light, rainy blue night tones at the airport turning into warm golden morning tones in the cafe, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look, quiet romantic-comedy mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

lines.text: Reys kechikdi, quvvatlagich ishlamaydi… eng yomon kecha!

scenes.prompt: Night at an almost empty airport gate. The young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf sits on the floor against the glass, rain streaming down the window behind her; she types fast on her phone with both thumbs, sighs, and hits send. Audio: rain on glass, a distant boarding announcement chime, a sharp message whoosh. She mutters in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Reys kechikdi, quvvatlagich ishlamaydi… eng yomon kecha!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Doʻstimga yozgandim. Lekin bitta raqamni xato bosgan ekanman.

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf staring at her phone in the dim gate light; her eyes widen, she covers her mouth with one hand and shakes her head at herself. Audio: a soft heartbeat thump, rain. She says off-screen as a quiet inner voice, in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Do'stimga yozgandim. Lekin bitta raqamni xato bosgan ekanman." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Ogʻir kecha ekan. Yaxshi boʻlib ketar. Aeroport qahvasi ham shunchalik yomonmi?

scenes.prompt: The phone in the young woman's hands buzzes and lights her face; she reads, frowns in surprise, then a small laugh escapes her and she looks down at the paper cup of airport coffee beside her and wrinkles her nose. Audio: a phone buzz, a soft surprised laugh. An unseen man's voice reads his message off-screen in Uzbek with a friendly, easy-going young male voice of about 30: "Og'ir kecha ekan. Yaxshi bo'lib ketar. Aeroport qahvasi ham shunchalik yomonmi?" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oylar oʻtdi. Ism aytmadik, rasm almashmadik. Ogʻir kunlar, kichik gʻalabalar — hammasini bir-birimizga yozdik.

scenes.prompt: Morning in the small cosy coffee shop. Slow sideways dolly past the tables: the young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf at the window table smiles at her phone as she types; three tables away the young man in round tortoiseshell glasses and a charcoal coat also types and smiles at his phone. Neither looks up. Steam rises from both cups. Audio: soft cafe murmur, milk frother, gentle piano. She says off-screen as a narrator, in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Oylar o'tdi. Ism aytmadik, rasm almashmadik. Og'ir kunlar, kichik g'alabalar — hammasini bir-birimizga yozdik." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Balki endi uchrasharmiz? Uyingiz yonidagi kafeda.

scenes.prompt: Evening at home by a window with city lights; the young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf sits on a sofa, the phone buzzes, she reads, presses the phone to her chest, takes a deep breath, then nods to herself. Audio: a phone buzz, a clock ticking, her nervous exhale. An unseen man's voice reads his message off-screen in Uzbek with a friendly, easy-going young male voice of about 30: "Balki endi uchrasharmiz? Uyingiz yonidagi kafeda." Then she whispers in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Uchrashamiz…" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Notanish yuzni qidirdim. Hech kimni topa olmadim.

scenes.prompt: Afternoon. The young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf walks into the small cosy coffee shop, stops by the door and slowly scans the room from table to table, holding her phone tightly. Point-of-view glances over ordinary customers. Audio: a door bell jingle, cafe murmur, her steps. She says off-screen as a narrator, in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Notanish yuzni qidirdim. Hech kimni topa olmadim." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Anavi yigitmi? U bir yildan beri har kuni ertalab siz bilan bir vaqtda keladi-ku!

scenes.prompt: The barista in the coffee-brown apron and red bandana leans over the counter laughing and points across the room toward the young man in round tortoiseshell glasses three tables away; the young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf turns her head slowly to follow her finger. Audio: a coffee grinder stops, a short laugh. The barista says in Uzbek with a cheerful, laughing female voice of about 40: "Anavi yigitmi? U bir yildan beri har kuni ertalab siz bilan bir vaqtda keladi-ku!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir yil davomida biz uch stol narida oʻtirgan ekanmiz.

scenes.prompt: The young man in round tortoiseshell glasses stands up from his table holding his phone and a coffee cup, and the young woman in the mustard-yellow scarf stands facing him; they look at each other in disbelief, then both start laughing. Audio: cafe murmur fades, a warm piano chord. He says in Uzbek with a friendly, easy-going young male voice of about 30, raising his cup: "Aeroport qahvasi… bunisidan yomonroq edi." Then she says off-screen as a narrator, in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28: "Bir yil davomida biz uch stol narida o'tirgan ekanmiz." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Siz ham telefonga qarab, yoningizdagi odamni koʻrmay yurmayapsizmi? Izohda yozing.

scenes.prompt: Both of them sit at the same small table by the window, they place their phones face down on the table at the same moment and smile at each other; the camera slowly pulls back through the window into the street. Audio: two soft taps of phones on wood, street sounds, the piano melody resolves. She says off-screen as a narrator, in Uzbek with a soft, tired-but-warm young female voice of about 28, gently: "Siz ham telefonga qarab, yoningizdagi odamni ko'rmay yurmayapsizmi? Izohda yozing." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
